_shifts_comment: Verified against a live entry on the real site (previous version of this file was an unverified guess made while the list was empty, and it wrongly matched section headers and empty spacer divs in addition to real rows, badly inflating counts). Each entry is a direct-child '.row.col-sm-12' block inside the page's outer '.col-sm-12' container; a nested '.row.col-sm-12' also exists one level deeper inside each entry for layout purposes, so the '>' direct-child combinator is required to avoid matching it twice. No pay rate is shown anywhere on this page, so that field is expected to stay empty.
